notes: This registry tracks candidate RL CPU models only. Model artifacts are intentionally not committed.
Prefer 20-game JS evaluations for promotion decisions. 4-game checkpoint evaluations are noisy.
Current policy: keep multiple models when their build tendencies differ and their JS evaluations are useful.

Business center diagnostic on 2026-04-20 after fixing card-name stats: seed102 4p used BC once across 150 evaluated games and completed the exchange (パン屋->サンマ漁船 vs strong). Representative 2p candidates seed71-top3, seed69, and h128-lr1e4 used BC zero times across 150 games each. Current models are not BC-dependent; BC head improvements are therefore a future strength-ceiling issue, not a current adoption blocker.

portfolioPolicy.goal: Keep several RL CPU models with distinct build tendencies, not only the single highest win-rate model.
selectionAxes: top card and landmark build tendencies

recommendedActiveModels.reason: Adopted for 3-player and 4-player RL CPU. 100-game lineup evaluation stayed stable against normal/strong mixed tables.

portfolioPolicy.archiveGuidance: Archive candidates only when both strength and strategy overlap with a better model. Keep weaker models if they provide clearly different build behavior.
